reason: The shared host filesystem reached ENOSPC during production image compilation. A shell heredoc and a new sandbox startup failed. Ctrl-C was explicitly sent to the owned gate, which terminated130 and canceled its Docker build. This was not an observation timeout or a source35 API reconciliation failure.
limits: Seven completed stages do not qualify an image or a complete release.

Private compiler/cache metadata paths changed only after final host builds; five linked executable hashes remained identical. Source archives, actual executables, database data, images and evidence files were preserved.

Two rebuildable .d dependency-metadata files were removed to allow sandbox startup. The failed direct .rlib replacement left the original archive unchanged, as its later archive signature and original SHA256 were verified before cache-only removal.
Filesystem exhaustion is observed; this report does not attribute all shared-host disk consumption to this gate.
